name: MELD K2 versus K5 semantic-paraphrase AI-only exploratory pilot
review: One input-only AI author + independent input-only AI reviewer. Both PASS required; uncertainty/FAIL retained.

matching.cap_rule: Seeded SHA sort of eligible Dialogue IDs; then one seeded SHA-minimal existing pair per Dialogue, 24 distinct Dialogue. No response-based selection or replacement.

perturbations.original_variants: Frozen a/b text and original AI review unchanged; new c/d/e generated once and kept even when they fail
perturbations.controls: Same frozen CMERC/RoBERTa, target-only re-encode; clean feature+probability check for every target before variant inference.
perturbations.missing: Separate K2 and complete K5 scope; primary paired comparison requires both matched endpoints with all five PASS and input QC; no rematch or K shrink.

diagnostics: all K2/K3/K4 subsets as dependent combinations
analysis.scope: Reused MELD Validation; feasibility and version sensitivity only; no independent confirmation or score fitting
analysis.note: K2/K5 agreement shares two variants. K5 is not an independent truth nor directly replicated; report disjoint repeat variability and subset sensitivity.
